authoritative_endpoints: GitHub repository and Git tree APIs
LANL Cyber Security Research dataset page
inclusion_criteria: publisher or repository identity is public
license or public-domain status is explicit at the official endpoint
revision, DOI version, checksum, or immutable commit can be pinned
publisher and source-generation family do not overlap the four train and two development families
directory-level metadata makes at least four future lineage groups plausible
source can yield security event or security-text packets without hidden labels in the model view
exclusion_criteria: same corpus family or data-generating testbed as train or development
only one parser fixture or no plausible independent lineage groups
labels, tactic names, actor names, or answer keys cannot be physically detached
source is vulnerability knowledge only and does not test the candidate evidence editor
immutable version cannot be pinned from examined metadata
search_limitations: This is a targeted source-gate search, not a systematic census of all security datasets.
No archive member or data record was opened, so exact lineage, sample-kind, pointer, and trusted-modality capacity remains unverified.
Pretraining contamination is unknown for every public candidate.
A metadata candidate is not an approved test family and does not satisfy the L2 quota.

metadata_candidates.publisher: Carnegie Mellon University Software Engineering Institute CERT Division, ExactData LLC, and DARPA I2O
approval_conditions: Select exactly one release archive; do not mix superseding releases.
Keep answers.tar.bz2 physically excluded from model view and source normalization.
Run nested notice, checksum, protected exclusion, and duplicate scans before any payload read is accepted.
Define lineage from synthetic scenario, user, and bounded time metadata; archive or row count is not lineage.
Strip scenario, malicious-user, and answer-key labels from paths and model-visible fields.
Report the source as synthetic and do not claim real-enterprise generalization.
Re-audit sample-kind and modality capacity before source approval.

metadata_findings.format_overlap_with_development: Zeek conn.log format overlaps zeek_non_pcap_test_logs, but capture corpus and publisher are independent.

approval_conditions: Use only non-PCAP flow/log artifacts; PCAP payload remains out of scope.
If the light archive is used, compute and freeze its own checksum because the examined Zenodo record pins only the full archive.
Treat one capture scenario as at most one lineage group; rows and flows do not create replicates.
Remove malware, device, scenario, and label fields from model-visible input and source paths.
Do not use the label spreadsheet or labeled suffix as model input; any future private scorer use requires separate gold authority.
Measure and disclose Zeek-format correlation with the development family.
Run nested notice, protected exclusion, and near-duplicate scans before source approval.
